name: systemix
description: The design system agent for Claude Code, free and open source. Four commands: /systemix:setup builds your design system and its rules from your code, /systemix:brief gives the rules before you build, /systemix:check checks the work against them (with a free AI-readiness score), and /systemix:loop takes a goal to shipped with a person at every gate. Everything runs on your machine; nothing is sent.
